nodes.text: It sounds like the team has started without me. I hope everything is going okay.

nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. This is basic stuff. Just think back to your classes. Now what's your answer?

nodes.text: I know! Cupcakes!

nodes.text: The truth is, Spartan Academy has a really tough Quiz Bowl team. They `crushed` Wilson High in the semi-finals.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So we need to get you up to speed `fast.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So we need to get you up to speed [color=#3b78e2][i]fast.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: First things first, I'll explain how Quiz Bowl works.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: In the main phase of the competition, each team member will answer questions in a particular subject.

nodes.text: But I'm terrible at Math!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And then some.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, after the main phase of the competition is over, the judge will select one member at random from each team and ask them a special `bonus question.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda, after the main phase of the competition is over, the judge will select one member at random from each team and ask them a special [color=#3b78e2][i]bonus question.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The bonus question can be from any subject, so even though we each have a specialty, we all have to practice everything in order to be fully prepared. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess 'maybe' will have to do. Next, I'll answer some questions to show you how it's done!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really? But what if I'm wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What if I'm misinterpreting the facts because I have a fever, and my fronds won't stop swelting?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Do you mean, 'Your `palms` won't stop `sweating`'?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you mean, 'Your [color=#3b78e2][i]palms[/i][/color] won't stop [color=#3b78e2][i]sweating[/i][/color]'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why? Did I do it again?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cough... Sometimes when my temperature spikes, I get delirious and confuse things with other things that are different but related.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, like pants and stockings, or shoes and shoeboxes.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I guess that explains the ridiculous get-up you're wearing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But given your unique condition, you should probably rest up before you make any potentially life-altering decisions.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you're probably right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Listen, I know Dinah, and I know for certain she'd be upfront with you if she was having second thoughts about your relationship.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But even if I were wrong, and I'm `not...` Don't you think you should wait to have this conversation until you both feel better?
nodes.text_bbcode: But even if I were wrong, and I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not...[/i][/color] Don't you think you should wait to have this conversation until you both feel better?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you're right about keeping this to myself, too. Cough... I'd hate to say something I regretted just because I'm delirious with fever.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Besides, once a name is submitted to the Quiz Bowl judging committee, it's absolutely `final.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, once a name is submitted to the Quiz Bowl judging committee, it's absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]final.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: They only allowed a substitution for Brendan, because we were able to prove he was much too ill to compete.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Welcome aboard, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Does this mean I get my extra credit?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
Angie and Amanda step out into the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So it looks like you're officially on the team.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Do we get pretty, matching uniforms?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh, no, but we do have practice after school in room 201. Be sure not to be late, okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: One last question, Amanda. You're a cheerleader, right? You're really fit. How did you manage to get a D- in P.E.?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It turns out that when they tell Jack to jump, they really mean everybody.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: See you tomorrow!
Amanda skips down the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ugh. I wish $Scott weren't at that wilderness retreat for the Future Leaders of Centerscore. I'm sure he'd know `exactly` what to do in a situation like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. I wish $Scott weren't at that wilderness retreat for the Future Leaders of Centerscore. I'm sure he'd know [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what to do in a situation like this.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess it's up to me.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I should swing by Brendan's house before Quiz Bowl practice to see how he's doing.
Later that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Angie... Cough... Is that you? What are you doing here? Don't you know I'm highly contagious?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, that's kind of what this plastic bag is for.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Well, if you're willing to take the risk, I want you to tell me what's happening with Quiz Bowl. Did Ms. Lee find a replacement for me yet?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Kind of... It's Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Amanda?! But she thinks the `FOIL Method` is a new way of highlighting her hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda?! But she thinks the [color=#e23b3b][i]FOIL Method[/i][/color] is a new way of highlighting her hair!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unfortunately, there's nothing I can do. Apparently, once a name gets submitted to the Quiz Bowl judging committee, it's final.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway, that's enough about me and my problems. How did Dinah react when you told her you had mono?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Actually, she's the one who gave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. She told me she got it from a drinking fountain in her dorm, but I'm a little suspicious.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You think Dinah lied to you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No. I mean, yes. I mean, maybe... What I'm trying to say is, Dinah's in college now, and I'm still in high school.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It could all be nothing, but it could also be a sign that Dinah's moving on emotionally, and if that were the case...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, Brendan, I'm no expert, but if I were you, I'd...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, look at what you've done, Angie! You've gone and hurt Amanda's feelings.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, I'm sorry, but...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No! I'm sorry! I'm sorry you think that 'being smart' is something you can quantify.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry you think people have some kind of intelligence quotient you can measure with a test.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Um, but isn't that what an IQ test is supposed to...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hush! Now, Angie, I want you to look at Amanda. Look really, really, really deep.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Do you see that? Do you? Amanda's very smart... `On the inside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you see that? Do you? Amanda's very smart... [color=#3b78e2][i]On the inside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You just have to find a way to bring all that smartness out into the open where everyone else can see it, too.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hm... I wasn't aware there were any physical requirements.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, they're not official. It's just that all the guys think Amanda is really, really hot.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: They do? I like them!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right, but you see... Our team has a hard enough time concentrating on our practice questions without Dex drooling on the cheerleader sitting next to him.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So, Amanda, do you see what I'm saying?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't sit in the drooly chair?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Amanda, Angie is trying to explain that you'll add diversity to an otherwise homogenous 'in group'.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And as far as I'm concerned, being smart enough to avoid virus-laden saliva puts Amanda one up on Brendan.
Angie opens the door and peaks into Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And then I said, 'You think `you've` got problems. I'm a grown woman in a dead-end job giving bad advice to school children...'
nodes.text_bbcode: And then I said, 'You think [color=#3b78e2][i]you've[/i][/color] got problems. I'm a grown woman in a dead-end job giving bad advice to school children...'

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me. Ms. Lee, the office secretary said you were available, and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Are you talking to the stapler?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, Angie! Don't mind all that. I'm glad you stopped by.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I heard about the Quiz Bowl team's problems, and I've come up with a solution. Here. Try this.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But... But this is a plastic bag.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Exactly! Place one of these over your head whenever you make out, and you'll be sure to prevent the further spread of infection.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee... I think. But what we really need is another team member.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ooh! I'm on top of that, too!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I found the perfect candidate. She's highly intelligent and desperately needs some extra credit to offset the D- she received in P.E.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Smart, bad at sports... She sounds perfect! When can I meet her?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Right now! Ahem... Would the newest member of the Quiz Bowl team please step into my office?
The door handle jiggles. There is a pause. The door handle jiggles again.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Turn the handle, `then` push.
nodes.text_bbcode: Turn the handle, [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] push.

nodes.text: The door opens. Amanda topples in!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Meep!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda?! She's the replacement for Brendan?! This has to be some kind of joke!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Nope. No joke. I've already submitted her name to the Quiz Bowl judging committee.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Smart?! But that's exactly the problem. Brendan is the smartest kid in school!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... I wouldn't exactly go `that` far.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I wouldn't exactly go [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] far.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, fine, but who are we going to get to replace him in the Math challenge?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...I heard Spike was thinking about doing an extracurricular activity.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Spike's a great guy, but he's a fifth year high school senior.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah. Are we even sure he can count to ten?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay. So Spike's out, but there's got to be `someone` out there who can do it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay. So Spike's out, but there's got to be [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] out there who can do it.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Who?! Name one person.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right. I admit. I don't know off the top of my head, but...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Face it, Angie. Dex's right. If there was anybody else as good at math as Brendan, don't you think we'd know by now?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...I guess you're right, but before we throw in the towel, I should probably speak to our faculty adviser.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know it's a long shot, but Ms. Lee might have a replacement for us.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Calm?! `Calm?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Calm?! [color=#e23b3b][i]Calm?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Dex, just take a deep breath, and calculate Pi to forty decimal places, okay? Can you do that for me?
A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah. I was in total panic mode there, wasn't I? Thanks for talking me off the ledge.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I do know that nothing gets your head straight like calculating irrational numbers.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's good that we're all calm now, but we still need to find a fourth team member.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll talk with Ms. Lee, our faculty adviser. Maybe she can help us out.

nodes.text: There's got to be something that we can do, right? I mean, we've worked way too hard to just quit now.

nodes.text: Amanda, do you see? You might have trouble with math, but you're a genius at `Mallgebra!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda, do you see? You might have trouble with math, but you're a genius at [color=#3b78e2][i]Mallgebra![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Huh, I guess I just never thought about math in those terms before. Or even at all.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, Angie!

nodes.text: Well, if you can do this again tomorrow at the Quiz Bowl, we may even stand a chance of beating Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: At least you get to work in the field harvesting bananas. The real Amanda and I are stuck cleaning ticks off the monkey Amanda's body and then `eating` them!
nodes.text_bbcode: At least you get to work in the field harvesting bananas. The real Amanda and I are stuck cleaning ticks off the monkey Amanda's body and then [color=#3b78e2][i]eating[/i][/color] them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yech! It's like summer camp all over again.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ENOUGH! Less talking, more grooming!
Oh no! How is this even possible?! You set out to win the Quiz Bowl, and somehow you allowed a hyper-intelligent monkey to take over the world?
You have no choice! You must play again immediately to set things right!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In Biology, the binomial naming system was standardized by...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Everything?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, yeah. I mean, the bonus round question is chosen at random.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The judge could ask you literally anything, and you'll need to be able to answer him on the spot.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Carry the 1... Divide by x... Hypotenuse of a right triangle... Brain starting to overload...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's no use! I'll never remember any of this.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh-oh. Amanda looks pretty frazzled. Maybe I should've been more encouraging.
Amanda slinks on stage and takes a spot next to Preston.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This is the bonus round, Amanda. The question you'll be asked is chosen at random.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It could literally be anything!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We do our best to prepare, but ultimately, a lot of it just comes down to luck.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So try to relax, cross your fingers, and hope that the judge asks you a question you can answer.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And whatever happens, know that your team is here for you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, Angie. I know I wasn't your first choice to be on the team.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But your support really means a lot!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Amanda, we're rooting for you!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Totally! Now get out there and kick some Spartan butt!
Amanda strides confidently on stage and takes a spot next to Preston.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Have some faith, Amanda. I know you've had trouble, but I still think you can do this.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Spartan Academy has 215 points, and Centerscore High has 200 points.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Spartan Academy is ahead for now, but remember, the special bonus question will be worth 25 points.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Whichever team gets it right, will win this year's Quiz Bowl competition!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We're down on points, but the bonus question is where our team can really shake things up.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If we get it right, we'll beat them!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Angie, you may now return to your seat.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ugh... That wasn't very good. I guess it's up to the rest of the team to pick up the slack.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Let's hope they weren't too discouraged.
And so, the competition continues...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In Literature, `20,000 Leagues Under the Sea` was written by...
nodes.text_bbcode: In Literature, [color=#e23b3b][i]20,000 Leagues Under the Sea[/i][/color] was written by...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Edgar Rice Burroughs?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Incorrect!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In European History, Saint Joan d'Arc is also known as the...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The Maid of... Um, the Maid of...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Dex. Time is up.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In Geometry, a shape with sides of the same length is referred to as...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Je m'apple Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, that's quizzical.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And incorrect!
Until finally...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we have reached the end of the main phase of the competition.
Judge Tigh strolls onto the stage and addresses the contestants.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the Quiz Bowl will now begin. As you all know, we will ask questions in four categories...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Science, History, Literature, and Math!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Each correct answer is worth points, and at the end of the competition, the team that's accumulated the most points wins.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Let's begin. Our first subject is... `Science!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's begin. Our first subject is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Science![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's you, Angie!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah! Knock 'em dead! Uh, I mean, figuratively, that is!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Er, unless you need to dissect a frog, because in that case, it would probably be better if the frog were `literally` dead instead of...
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, unless you need to dissect a frog, because in that case, it would probably be better if the frog were [color=#e23b3b][i]literally[/i][/color] dead instead of...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ew! Angie, just do your best.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks, guys. I will.
Angie crosses to the podium at the center of the stage.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Angie, are you ready? Let's begin.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I may be only one subject out of four, but as Team Captain, my performance will inspire or discourage my team members.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I really need to be good!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Heh. Fine by me. You compete. We'll `win.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Fine by me. You compete. We'll [color=#e23b3b][i]win.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That's your snappy rejoinder? 'Grr'? You're definitely going to have to think faster on your feet if you want to beat Spartan.
Preston struts back to his seat.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm so dumb! I shouldn't have let him get me rattled like that. Looks like this competition is off to a bad start.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Uh, omni-`what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, omni-[color=#e23b3b][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Andrew, would you mind explaining what I just said to our rival?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not a problem. Omnilegence means 'having encyclopedic curiosity or knowledge'.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Which clearly you `don't` have, because if you did, you wouldn't need us to give you definitions.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which clearly you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] have, because if you did, you wouldn't need us to give you definitions.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Dictionary!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you guys are... Are... Dumb!
Preston slinks back to his seat, visibly rattled.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Heh. He tried to intimidate us, but we intimidated him! I'd say this competition is off to a great start!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know that, but listen...  Last night, Amanda showed some real promise.
Angie rushes around the store and gathers up articles of ugly clothing...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hm, these don't look right, but I guess they'll have to do.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, Amanda, say you wanted to buy these lime green overalls for 32.49, but you only had 16 dollars in allowance...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But why would I want to wear overalls?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm not saying you do, but `if` you did...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not saying you do, but [color=#3b78e2][i]if[/i][/color] you did...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But don't I look cute in short skirts? Are you telling me my thighs look big?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, Amanda, I...
Amanda digs through her purse and finds a pack of sugar-free gum.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Two calories per stick?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's `two` too many!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] too many!

nodes.text: Amanda chucks the gum across the store!

nodes.speaker: Store Clerk
nodes.text: Hey, you can't be throwing things in here! Get out!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wait! I didn't buy the necklace yet!

nodes.speaker: Store Clerk
nodes.text: Too bad! If you really want it, you can come back later without that psycho redhead.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. Let's go.
A few minutes later, in the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm sorry you didn't get the necklace, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's not a problem. I can always come back tomorrow after the competition.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The important thing is that I saw a glimmer of genius in you tonight.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If you can do it again at the Quiz Bowl, we may even stand a chance of beating Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really?
Amanda pulls you into a bear hug!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
The next morning, right before the Quiz Bowl begins...
Angie approaches Ms. Lee and her assembled team...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I have great news! Amanda and I were at the mall last night, and she did this amazing...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You were at the mall?! You were `supposed` to be studying.
nodes.text_bbcode: You were at the mall?! You were [color=#e23b3b][i]supposed[/i][/color] to be studying.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A few weekends ago, when Dinah and I were at the mall together, we saw an ivory skull necklace that had two tiny rubies for pupils.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hm. That doesn't sound like something I'd wear, but I bet Dinah would love it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. There's only one problem. Cough... I'm too sick and weak to go pick it up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They only had the one, and if it sold out...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan, I'd love to help, but Amanda and I are studying for the Quiz Bowl right now and...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So if Train A is traveling at 30 miles per hour, and Train B is heading towards it at 45 miles per hour... Ohmygosh! We have to help them!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan, on second thought, it probably won't make a difference if we take a short break to visit the mall...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Angie. You're the best!
An hour later, Angie and Amanda visit Odd Topic...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So Dinah is really `that` mad at Brendan?
nodes.text_bbcode: So Dinah is really [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] mad at Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yep, but he's hoping this necklace will change all that.

nodes.speaker: Store Clerk
nodes.text: Hey, ladies, need some help?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yes, I'd like to buy that skull necklace.

nodes.speaker: Store Clerk
nodes.text: No problem. Your total comes to 43 dollars and 30 cents.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh-oh... I don't have that much. Brendan only gave me 35 dollars.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure, you do. You have plenty!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's simple, Angie. You have 35 dollars, but you get 25 percent off if you sign up for the mailing list. Plus tax, that equals 32 dollars and 48 cents.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not only do you have enough money to buy the necklace, you have enough money left over to treat yourself to a smoothie afterwards!
The clerk types a few numbers into the register...

nodes.speaker: Store Clerk
nodes.text: Whoa! She's right! Down to the penny!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, that was amazing! You just did really complicated math in your head!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I did?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah! What's more, calculating sales tax, subtracting percentages from a total... Those are exactly the sort of things you'll have to do at the Quiz Bowl!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Here, let's try it again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, I need to find a fun item for Amanda to purchase. If I select well, I'm sure Amanda will understand what I'm trying to explain.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Apologize?! What do you think I've been trying to do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How can I apologize to Dinah if she won't pick up the phone, or respond to my emails or text messages or FaceSpace wall posts?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've totally run out of options. If there were only something I could do to get her attention.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I don't know. Maybe you could...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! I know!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A present?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Of course! Listen, Dinah might be a special kind of girl, but she's still a girl.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And as long as there have been couples, guys have been screwing up and then buying their girlfriends jewelry to make up for it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sure. How do you think I got those cute silver hoop earrings I wore yesterday? Or the opal necklace I wore to the dance? Or that teak jewelry box I keep all of $Scott's other presents in?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow! $Scott must screw up a lot.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sure, he does. All guys do. And for some strange primordial reason, getting a present from your boyfriend makes everything all better again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hm, well, if it works for you, it might work for Dinah, too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I think I know exactly what I want to get her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why did I say it? You suggested it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But then I changed my mind!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, like I'm supposed to remember everything people say when I have a temperature of 103!
Later that night, Angie and Amanda work on math problems...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So if the two legs of the right triangle are 5 feet and 12 feet respectively, how many feet long is the hypotenuse?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thir... Thirtyfourteen?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, thirtyfourteen isn't even a number!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe that's why I could never get my locker open...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aw, it's hopeless. I'm just no good at math.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You can be, Amanda. These things just take practice. It's important to keep at it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay.
Just then, the phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, you keep working on those math problems, while I take this call.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Angie, I don't know what I was thinking! You have to help me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan, are you all right? What happened?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was just talking to Dinah about how she got mono, and one thing led to another, and...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think I might've said that I didn't trust her.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why would you say that?!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: The final point total is Spartan Academy, 240, and Centerscore High, 200!
Great, but not quite `perfect.` Try again to unlock the hidden bonus scene.
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, but not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Try again to unlock the hidden bonus scene.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, you're really, really smart.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If you want to stay with the team, we'll find a spot for you. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: The final point total is Spartan Academy, 215, and Centerscore High, 225!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway, Dinah got really mad... Cough... And now she's not talking to me! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's obvious, Brendan. You have to...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Which means... `Centerscore High wins!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means... [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerscore High wins![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The crowd erupts with thunderous applause!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: She did it! Amanda got it right! We won!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I don't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She really is a genius!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And super hot to boot!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I think we've all learned a valuable lesson today.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You should listen to your guidance counselor more often. Isn't that right, Mr. Staples?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh... Okay?
Twenty minutes later, Angie exits the auditorium and walks over to Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Amanda, you did it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I did, and it was really nice to feel smart for a change.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For a change...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know, Angie, and I had a really good time with you guys, but the truth is that cheerleading competitions are coming up and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And that's where your passion really is. I can appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks for being so understanding...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Besides, Dex repeats himself whenever I sit next to him. It kind of freaks me out.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hot and smart... Does not compute... `Does not compute...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hot and smart... Does not compute... [color=#e23b3b][i]Does not compute...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Later that night, the phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Angie, I wanted to call you up and congratulate you on your victory!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, who would've guessed that Amanda was a secret genius?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, it came as a real shock to everybody!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I also wanted to thank you for picking up that skull necklace for me from the mall.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right after I sent it over, Dinah called me up, and we had a long talk.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm happy to report that everything's fine now!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. Long distance relationships can be tough, but it helps to have support from good friends.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway, congrats on the win, and have a wonderful night!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Good night!
Angie hangs up her cell phone. A moment later, she gets a text!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey! $Scott's back from his leadership conference, and he wants me to come over to celebrate my Quiz Bowl victory with him!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I think I've earned a little fun. I'll be right over!
Well, it looks like Angie's taking off, and that's our cue to take off, too!
In the meantime, we've got a quiz question for you: 'Who just played a great game of `Surviving High School?`'
nodes.text_bbcode: In the meantime, we've got a quiz question for you: 'Who just played a great game of [b]Surviving High School?[/b]'

nodes.text: That's right! You did!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And the question is... 'In Astronomy, the unit 'solar mass' is used to describe the mass of distant stars and galaxies. How many kilograms is one solar mass?'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Um, uhh...
Preston slaps the buzzer.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Pfft. That's `easy.` One solar mass is two nonillion kilograms or approximately 333,000 times the mass of the Earth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft. That's [color=#e23b3b][i]easy.[/i][/color] One solar mass is two nonillion kilograms or approximately 333,000 times the mass of the Earth.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That answer is... Correct! For answering the bonus question correctly, 25 points are awarded to Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Spartan Academy wins!
The crowd erupts with thunderous applause!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Heh. Suck it, nerds! Spartan Academy rules!
Amanda trudges back to her team.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Amanda, what happened out there?! How could you not know that?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I bet she didn't even know 'nonillion' was a real number.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry I let you all down.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, sorry doesn't change the fact that you made us lose!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You should `go.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You should [color=#e23b3b][i]go.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Amanda walks off, sad and alone...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh well, I suppose it's for the best. There's nothing between that girl's ears but pink fluffy fluff!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Amanda was only keeping this team down!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee, Amanda is only `on` the team because you put her there!
nodes.text_bbcode: But Ms. Lee, Amanda is only [color=#3b78e2][i]on[/i][/color] the team because you put her there!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hey! Do I pester you with irrelevant, little details?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Besides, I have a new candidate that's absolutely perfect! I'd like to introduce you all to your new Math Subject expert... Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heh. Whattup, losers?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh no... Not again!
Uh oh, this isn't too good! You lost the Quiz Bowl, and now you're teamed up with Ryan?!
You can definitely do better than that! Try again for a good ending!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: There's been an awful lot of talk about Mono, but how exactly `did` Dinah get it?
nodes.text_bbcode: There's been an awful lot of talk about Mono, but how exactly [b]did[/b] Dinah get it?

nodes.text: Through the magic of flashbacks, we can finally find out!
A few weeks ago, at Centerscore University...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Chuck, that party was so tight! I must've made out with like twelve girls!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Heh. You were speaking 'French' in a dozen different languages.
Bryce takes a drink of water from the fountain!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: The only problem is I'm feeling a little tired today, and I totally slept late, too. Kissing those girls must've really wiped me out.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Tired?! As in abnormally tired?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, so...?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: So you didn't make out with Camille, did you?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: ...Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Camille totally has mono! Dude, what were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You mean, she...? You mean, I...?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Bryce, stop whatever you're doing and go to the Campus Health Center to get checked out.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: If you're sick, the last thing you want to be doing is hanging out in public!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.
Chuck and Bryce slink off toward the Campus Health Center.
A few moments later, Dinah walks up to the water fountain. She talks on her cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know, Brendan! I can't wait to see you this weekend either!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Having my avatar kiss your avatar in `Warscrewdriver: Online` is a really fun game mechanic, but it's no substitute for making out `IRL.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Having my avatar kiss your avatar in [color=#3b78e2][i]Warscrewdriver: Online[/i][/color] is a really fun game mechanic, but it's no substitute for making out [color=#3b78e2][i]IRL.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hold on a sec. I'm going to take a sip of water.
Dinah drinks from the water fountain and gets splashed with fresh mono germs!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm back! Now where were we? Oh, that's right! Love you, too!
So there you have it! Dinah really `did` get mono from a drinking fountain. It looks like Brendan has nothing to fear!
nodes.text_bbcode: So there you have it! Dinah really [b]did[/b] get mono from a drinking fountain. It looks like Brendan has nothing to fear!

nodes.text: Except Brendan did have a point... Long distance romances `are` pretty difficult. Be sure to come back soon for more on Brendan and Dinah's relationship!
nodes.text_bbcode: Except Brendan did have a point... Long distance romances [b]are[/b] pretty difficult. Be sure to come back soon for more on Brendan and Dinah's relationship!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Goody!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, Amanda. The subject is Literature.

nodes.speaker: Angie
